title: Golden Registry & Regeneration
description: Maintain a registry of golden scenarios (one per template). Each entry pins the template id + version and on-disk path. Regenerate operation re-runs the template generator into the registered path and bumps the pinned version.

requirements.title: Golden registry domain module
requirements.description: SQLite-backed domain module under api/internal/golden/{model,sqlite,schema}.go,sql storing slug, template_id, template_version_pinned, path, created_at, last_regenerated_at.

validation.notes: Golden registry row round-trips through SQLite (slug, template, pinned version, path).
reference-react-vite golden registered and listed live 2026-05-29.

requirements.title: Regenerate operation
requirements.description: Service method that invokes the template generator (vrooli scenario create or equivalent) into the registered path, captures the new template version from templates/scenarios/<template>/template.json::version, and updates template_version_pinned + last_regenerated_at. Surfaces a result the operator must review and commit manually.

validation.notes: Regenerate updates pinned version and persists last_regenerated_at.
